result: MEASURED: no bank is free. Two free banks do not exist, so per the owner's rule this stops for a decision.

method.walk: definition pointer array at file 0x6B6BB4, 0x54-byte definition headers, the slot array at +0x54, animation records, frames, 12-byte piece records
method.containers: every piece's container is decoded with the project's proven codec tools/webfoot/formats/webfoot_lz.py, which decrypts kind 1 (packed). All 7,390 distinct containers are kind 1; the engine's dispatcher is at 0x0803D940 and its packed decoder is the ARM body at 0x087B79E4 reached through the 0x08049120 veneer.
method.opaque: index 0 is transparent in both depths and is excluded. 8bpp pieces only; the single 4bpp piece is counted separately.

closest_candidates.note: fewest pixels by three orders of magnitude

interpretation: No 16-consecutive-index block is untouched by other actors' art, so a bank cannot be taken without changing some character's colours somewhere in the game. Bank 14 is the only candidate within an order of magnitude of cheap: 12 of its 16 indices are used, by 22 definitions, for 5,968 opaque pixels out of 3,705,212 (0.16 percent).
owner_options: Cell's colours in bank 14 only, accepting that the 22 definitions that touch it lose up to the 12 indices involved, unless those actors never share a scene with Cell.
Per-scene selection: choose the slot pair per scene from what is on screen, which needs a runtime palette write and a per-scene decision at build time.
8bpp Cell with his exact palette, which consumes the whole OBJ palette and therefore excludes every other actor from his scenes.
Reduce Cell to 16 colours per frame with a deterministic slot map, losing at most 6 pixels per frame as measured earlier, requiring no palette space at all.
not_established: Which definitions the 22 for bank 14 correspond to by NAME: the text table at 0x6BCE8 is a word array of slot pointers and the id-to-slot mapping was not verified, so ids are reported rather than names.

Anything the engine writes into OBJ palette RAM at runtime. 25 literals of 0x05000200 and 54 literals inside the palette range exist in the image; their routines were not classified, so fade and flash writers are named in neither this measurement nor the option list yet.
Whether bank 14's 22 actors can ever share a scene with Cell.
note: Counts only. No ROM bytes appear in this file or in the script that produced it.
